integrity.proof_status: Self-reviewed with finite exhaustive checker; not externally audited.
integrity.scientific_scope: Exact positioned-coloring census and explicit asymptotic decay rate; not a general theory of finite coalgebras.

limitations: All results concern finite complete regular rooted trees with distinct child and parent modalities, finite vertex alphabets and ordinary greatest bisimulation; original strong-extensionality theory is not claimed new. Possible unindexed quantitative antecedents remain.
title: Exponential rarity and exact modal-type census for converse-bisimulation-rigid regular trees
